output_list.criticism: The mintToken function allows the owner to mint more tokens than the total supply. This can lead to token devalue, as the total supply is not updated accordingly. This vulnerability can be exploited by anyone who has the owner role.

The burn function allows the owner to burn more tokens than the total supply. This can lead to integer overflow, as the total supply is not updated accordingly. This vulnerability can be exploited by anyone who has the owner role.

The transfer function allows anyone to transfer more tokens than the balance of the sender. This can lead to integer overflow, as the balance of the sender is not updated accordingly. This vulnerability can be exploited by anyone who has the sender's tokens.
